speak.title: Role-play: does writing make a language better?
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: You think a language with a long written history is more advanced. Give two reasons. Ask your partner why they disagree, and try to change their mind.

b.text: You read about a big study of 30 languages. It found no universal pattern. Explain what the researchers did and say why the old idea may be wrong. Be polite but firm.

phrases: I've always thought that writing makes language more serious.
That's what many people believe, but the study didn't find that.
Could you give me an example?
I'm not convinced, because they only measured sentences.
That's a fair point, but it doesn't prove anything.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: did you change your partner's mind, and what is one thing you both agree on?
